name: Release manager
why: Runs a go or no-go check, sets the version and changelog, plans the rollback and checks the live site, the same path as the release checklist skill.

name: Release day rollback planner
why: Rates release risk and writes the pause points and way back, a quick start for a rollback plan.

name: Release a new version and prove it is live
why: Takes a project to a version, changelog, go or no-go call and live deploy with proof, useful for teams new to repeatable releases.

name: Check a release and its docs
why: Finds test gaps and stale docs before release, the readiness check behind good release notes.

name: Deploy Worker to Render coding prompt
why: Plans a Render config with secret names, startup checks and a rollback step, a common small-team hosting path.

name: Cut CI cost without weakening checks
why: Trims GitHub workflow cost and fixes permissions without dropping checks, a companion to the pipeline skill.

name: Find leaked keys, secure them and check your live site
why: Finds committed keys, plans rotation and moves secrets to safe storage, the first job after a pipeline secret leak.

name: Weekly dependency and security sweep
why: Checks packages and leaked keys weekly with a safe upgrade order, keeping pinned versions current.

name: Monthly cloud and AI bill keeper
why: Compares each month's cloud and AI bill with the last and suggests caps, matching the monthly cost check workflow.

name: Review AWS cost and resilience
why: Weighs AWS savings against resilience, a deeper companion to the cloud cost review skill.

name: Review Azure cost and resilience
why: Maps Azure resources with current price estimates and resilience risks for Azure clients.

name: Build a backup recovery rehearsal
why: Plans a safe restore test with an evidence log, the proof a backup works before any migration.

name: Investigate an AWS service incident
why: Gathers log evidence for an incident window on AWS, raw material for the incident timeline.

name: Turn an incident into a safer procedure
why: Turns an incident timeline into a blameless report, a safer procedure and tracked actions, like the after-an-outage workflow.

name: Prepare a service outage communication pack
why: Drafts the first notice, updates and all-clear from confirmed facts, alongside the customer incident update prompt.
